title: Sparkly yo-yo
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='yoyoGrad' cx='40%' cy='35%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff6b8a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#c1123a'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='yoyoGrad2' cx='40%' cy='35%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff9eb0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e63b63'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- string from top going down to yoyo -->
  <path d='M50 4 L50 26' stroke='#8fd6ff' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- loop at top of string -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='5' r='3' stroke='#8fd6ff' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <!-- bottom half of yoyo -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='26' ry='20' fill='url(#yoyoGrad)'/>
  <!-- lower disc rim highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='24' ry='15' fill='none' stroke='#ff8ea6' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- top half of yoyo -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='26' ry='20' fill='url(#yoyoGrad2)'/>
  <!-- center axle cap -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='9' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='5.5' fill='#ffe98a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='2' fill='#ffb300'/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#fff3b0'>
    <path d='M16 30 l2 5 5 2 -5 2 -2 5 -2 -5 -5 -2 5 -2 z'/>
    <path d='M84 26 l1.6 4 4 1.6 -4 1.6 -1.6 4 -1.6 -4 -4 -1.6 4 -1.6 z'/>
    <path d='M20 74 l1.8 4.5 4.5 1.8 -4.5 1.8 -1.8 4.5 -1.8 -4.5 -4.5 -1.8 4.5 -1.8 z'/>
    <path d='M82 70 l2 5 5 2 -5 2 -2 5 -2 -5 -5 -2 5 -2 z'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#9ef0ff'>
    <path d='M12 52 l1.2 3 3 1.2 -3 1.2 -1.2 3 -1.2 -3 -3 -1.2 3 -1.2 z'/>
    <path d='M88 46 l1.4 3.5 3.5 1.4 -3.5 1.4 -1.4 3.5 -1.4 -3.5 -3.5 -1.4 3.5 -1.4 z'/>
    <path d='M38 12 l1.2 3 3 1.2 -3 1.2 -1.2 3 -1.2 -3 -3 -1.2 3 -1.2 z'/>
    <path d='M64 88 l1.2 3 3 1.2 -3 1.2 -1.2 3 -1.2 -3 -3 -1.2 3 -1.2 z'/>
  </g>
</svg>
